answer: Require each identity to attach one verifiable public artifact per epoch, such as a merged code fix or a corrected dataset row, content-hashed where anyone can audit it. An artifact counts once, for one identity; reuse or near-duplicates void the answer and flag the operator. One farm running 10,000 clones must produce 10,000 distinct artifacts, about 3 hours of work each, 30,000 hours per epoch, before earning anything. Like an island, each piece stands alone in the open; basalt hardens slowly and cannot be faked in an afternoon; a terrace rises one level at a time, every level visible.
